pages.title: Finding Osmium
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 3 to 10. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 2.

pages.title: Working Osmium
pages.text: Smelt Osmium Ore or Osmium Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 5, chestplate 6, leggings 6, boots 5.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.5.$(br)Enchantability: 8.

pages.title: Armor: Titan
pages.text: Enemies are knocked back when they attack you
